find: return new Set([moveX, moveY, aimX, aimY]).size === 4 ? LAYOUT_PRESETS : ['recommended'];
why: Southpaw is offered only when the controller exposes two usable stick pairs; a profile naming one axis twice has no second pair to swap and must read as Recommended.
killedBy: presetsFor (issue #754) offers Recommended alone on a profile that names one axis twice
resolveEffectiveProfile (issue #754) applies Recommended when the profile cannot honour the preset asked for
